ranked.lens: cross-function SQL-expression summaries + E0713 shape census on bench/framework_scan (381 survivors)
ranked.observed: p06_helper_gap.py diagnostics=5 — E0713 at L14 run_a (`stmt = base(t)`, module def returning select(t)), L16 run_b (`cols_query(db_type)` returning text(literal) in both branches), L20 run_c (`stmt = apply_sorting(stmt, col)` pass-through helper), L27 Repo.get (`self._base_query(t)` same class), L31 Repo.page (`base_stmt = self._base_query(t); paginated = base_stmt.order_by(...)`). Census of the real corpus (fw_before.json, 381 E0713 read at source): 11 same-class-method helpers (agno `_get_traces_base_query` x4 + its `base_stmt.order_by` continuation x4, pgvector `_apply_user_scope` x3) + 3 module-level defs (v3_0_0 `_index_columns_query`, `_unique_indexes_query`, singlestore/utils `_rewritten_metrics_delete`) = 14 in-module; a further 20 use `apply_sorting` IMPORTED from a sibling module (SQLSUM-05). The remaining 347 are not helper-shaped (see notes).
ranked.prevalence: 14 of 381 corpus E0713 (3.7%) clear with an in-module summary; 34 (8.9%) with SQLSUM-05 added. Measured by reading every survivor's bindings (scratchpad/probes/sqlsum/census2.txt); the LOOP_LOG '~100' estimate is not supported.
ranked.design: Summary = per-module map qualname -> `rooted` | `passthrough(i)` | absent, computed in `py_to_ir` after `collect()` by a least fixpoint over `func_nodes` (helper calling helper converges in a few rounds; start empty, add a function when every `Return` in its body — not descending into nested defs/lambdas — is (a) a Call for which `_is_sql_expression(v, imp, helper_scope)` holds, where helper_scope carries the helper's own `_sql_expression_names` plus the current summary, or (b) a Name in the helper's sql_names; `passthrough(i)` when every Return is parameter i itself or a raw-clean method chain rooted at parameter i; any other Return — bare `return`, a str/BinOp/JoinedStr/IfExp, an unknown call, another parameter — leaves it absent, so `mixed`, `raw_helper`, `passthrough` in p07 stay sinks). Disqualify outright: any `Yield`/`YieldFrom` (generator), `AsyncFunctionDef` (an un-awaited call is a coroutine; only consume once Await is unwrapped, orchestrator item 1), any decorator other than staticmethod/classmethod/functools.cache|lru_cache, a name defined twice in the module (p07 `twice`), and a name that is also an import alias. Call-site resolution inside `_is_sql_expression`'s root check: bare `Name` callee -> module-level def only if the caller does not rebind/parameterise that name (`_assign_bindings` + params + nested defs, p07 r6/r7); `self.m(...)`/`cls.m(...)` -> the enclosing class's OWN def only, no inheritance lookup, and refused when any other class in the module defines `m` without a rooted summary (p07 Sub overrides Base.q with text(concat)); `Other.m()` never. `passthrough(i)` roots the call only when args[i] is a Name in `sql_names`, equals `self_name` (so `stmt = apply(stmt, ...)` closes the existing fixpoint), or is itself `_is_sql_expression`; the raw-entry walk still runs over the call's own args so `helper(text(x))` is refused. Plumb it as `_FnScope.sql_helpers` (qualname map) plus `cls_name` so `_FnScope.__call__` stays unchanged; `py_to_ir` needs the class qualname it already computes in `collect`. Audit: `mapping_table()` gains `sql_helper_summary: {"scope": "module", "self_resolution": "same-class-only, refused on in-module override", "disqualifiers": [...]}`, and per-file `meta` gains `sql_helpers: {qualname: "rooted"|"passthrough:i"}` so a reviewer can see exactly which helpers vouched. Tests (tests/test_py_frontend_sinks.py): the five p06 shapes clean; the eight p07 shapes fire; helper-calls-helper converges; passthrough with a raw-string argument fires; summary exposed in meta/mapping_table. Residual to push into q1: cross-MODULE overrides of `self.m` and cross-module helpers (SQLSUM-05) are outside the summary — over-flag preserved because those calls stay unrooted.
ranked.breaking_risk: framework_scan E0713 381 -> 367 (all 14 read as clean SQLAlchemy at source); ratchet unchanged (no detector). Risk is in the summary's own soundness — the p07 set must be the regression fence, and `self.` resolution must refuse on in-module overrides.
judge_reasons: p06 fires 5/5 on clean SQLAlchemy helpers and p07 fires 8/8 (the regression fence) -- probe-confirmed over-flag, so the relax is admissible, and the design's disqualifier list (generators, async, decorators, double defs, in-module overrides, no inheritance, no cross-module) is the right soundness posture. But by q3 pricing: 180 LOC of new summary machinery for 14 of 381 (3.7%) findings, well under the >=50 bar for a P1 precision fix, and the LOOP_LOG '~100' estimate is not supported (SQLSUM-11). Park until per-finding confidence (q6) is weighed against it; if built, `self.m` resolution must refuse on any in-module override.
